Class PickerFreezeGameTestsLogic

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somegoogly.gametest.PickerFreezeGameTestsLogic
public final class PickerFreezeGameTestsLogic extends Object
The server-owned freeze lifecycle (PickerFreezeService): NoAi capture and restore, the one-editor-per-mob contention rule, releasing the previous mob when an editor switches, and the persistent-marker crash recovery (a hard crash drops the live records but not the mob's marker tag, which the next join restores from). Each test drives the service directly on the server thread — the same calls the PickerFreezePacket handler and lifecycle events make — with a fresh random "player" UUID, and releases everything it froze before succeeding.

  • Method Details

    • freezeCapturesAndUnfreezeRestores

      public static void freezeCapturesAndUnfreezeRestores(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      Choosing a mob freezes it, and releasing it restores its AI. In game: as a creative operator, press K to open the picker and V on a cow; it stops moving. Press V again and it wanders as before.

    • freezePreservesAlreadyForcedNoAi

      public static void freezePreservesAlreadyForcedNoAi(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      A mob that had no AI before the picker keeps none after release. In game: /summon cow ~ ~ ~ {NoAI:1b}, choose it with V, and release it; it still stands still.

    • freezeRefusesSecondEditor

      public static void freezeRefusesSecondEditor(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      Only one player may edit a mob at a time. In game: with two creative operators, one chooses a cow with V; the second's V on it is refused with a message, and the cow stays frozen until the first releases it.

    • switchingMobsReleasesThePreviousOne

      public static void switchingMobsReleasesThePreviousOne(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      Choosing a new mob releases the previous one. In game: choose one cow with V, then another; the first starts wandering again while the second is frozen.

    • staleMarkerIsRestoredOnJoin

      public static void staleMarkerIsRestoredOnJoin(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      A mob left frozen by a crash recovers when it next loads. In game: choose a cow with V, run /save-all, then end the server process without a clean stop; after restarting and returning, the cow wanders again.

    • joinDuringLiveEditReassertsTheFreeze

      public static void joinDuringLiveEditReassertsTheFreeze(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      A chosen mob whose chunk reloads mid-edit stays frozen. In game: choose a cow with V, fly far enough away that its chunk unloads, and come back; it is still frozen, and releasing it with V lets it wander.
